title: Create the Market Intake Record
subtitle: Turn the overnight note into the first trusted record
scenario: It is 6:15 AM. An analyst at Meridian Energy has dropped overnight market notes into the intake system. The notes are unstructured. Your job is to extract the key fields the workflow needs before anything else can run.
input: Checked overnight prices. ERCOT hub spiked around 2am, hit $187/MWh briefly then settled near $142/MWh. Wind generation underperformed, about 60% of forecast. Gas prices up slightly. Trader flagged the hub spike for review. No action taken yet. Need approval if we move on this.
instructions: Find the peak price and the settled price.
Find the generation source and performance status.
Return a valid JSON object with those fields.
copilotPrompt: Extract structured JSON from this analyst note. Return fields for hub, peakPrice, settledPrice, generationFlag, and approvalRequired. Use true or false for boolean fields.
successMessage: Intake record built. The workflow now has structured data to work with.
editorHelper: Create one JSON object that the workflow can reuse downstream.

intro.subtitle: Create the first trusted record in the workflow

sections.title: What this record does
sections.body: The Market Intake Record turns overnight analyst notes into the first structured object the workflow can trust.

sections.title: Why the note is not enough
sections.body: A paragraph is useful for a person, but downstream automation needs stable fields: market, price signal, operating signal, and approval cue.

sections.title: Who reuses it
sections.body: Risk Evaluation, Approval Decision, and Morning Brief all read this record instead of reinterpreting the original note.

sections.title: Format you will use
sections.body: The record is saved as JSON because JSON gives each fact a clear field name and value.
